sections.title: Personal service *for decades*
body: Gary Sullivan, CEO and owner of TPi, has served clients in printing and promotional marketing for more than 40 years. Clients call him “Printerman.”
TPi pairs an extensive line of products and services with marketing know-how and personal customer service, which is why its customers have stayed for decades.

quote.text: I enjoy doing business with Gary Sullivan… because he is personable and easy to work with. TPi has printed numerous publications for the City of Aiken Tourism Division over the last four years.
quote.by: Mary Ward Rosbach, City of Aiken Parks, Recreation and Tourism

items.a: Yes. We offer logos, concepts, layout and ad design, as well as website design and video production.

items.q: Do you print everyday business forms?
items.a: Yes: carbonless forms, labels, tags, pocket folders and anything else that keeps your operation running smoothly.
Of course. Call to set up a meeting and we’ll bring more of our work.
